title: How to calculate a median with a condition (MEDIANIF)
task: The median of only the rows matching a criterion — no MEDIANIFS exists, so here's the pattern.

excel.note: Excel 365/2021. Older Excel: =MEDIAN(IF(A2:A6="East",B2:B6)) entered with Ctrl+Shift+Enter.

libreoffice.note: FILTER needs 24.8+; the CSE MEDIAN(IF(...)) form works in older versions.

explanation: AVERAGEIF and SUMIF have -IF versions; MEDIAN never got one in any of the three apps. FILTER fills the gap: it hands MEDIAN just the East values (150, 80, 200), whose middle is 150. Any condition FILTER accepts works — numeric thresholds, dates, multiple ANDed tests. The pre-dynamic-array MEDIAN(IF(...)) array formula does the same everywhere, entered with Ctrl+Shift+Enter in old versions.
